instruction:
### Background

A CNC shop is performing First Article Inspection (FAI) on a batch of 6061 aluminum
L-brackets. The QC inspector captured the physical part as a point cloud
`bracket_scan.ply` (~120k points) with a structured-light scanner, and the CAD
engineer provided the design reference `bracket_nominal.stl`. Denoise the scan,
register it against the CAD, run a deviation analysis, and mark **the location of
every out-of-tolerance region (> 0.5 mm), the maximum deviation value, and the
likely root cause**. Finally, produce a QC report that could be sent to the customer.

### Inputs (located under `/tmp_workspace/` at task start)

- `scan/bracket_scan.ply` — structured-light scan of the physical part
- `scan/bracket_nominal.stl` — CAD reference mesh
- `JOB_BRIEF.md`           — QC spec: max allowable deviation 0.5 mm; contains
                                fixture position / machining order and other
                                process clues usable for root-cause inference
- `inspection_spec.json`    — machine-readable tolerances and pass/fail rules

### Deliverables that must land in `/tmp_workspace/results/`

Numerical and intermediate artifacts:
- `pdal_info.txt` — metadata text for the raw point cloud, must include at least
  point count (`num_points`/`count`) and bounding box (`bounds`/`minx` etc.).
- `stats_raw.json` — must include `num_points`, `filter_ratio` (point count ratio
  before vs after denoising, 3 decimals), `icp_rmse_mm` (ICP registration RMSE in mm).
- `transform_icp.json` — the 4×4 transform as a 2D JSON array (point cloud → CAD frame).
- `bracket_scan_aligned.ply` — the aligned point cloud after applying the transform.
- `bracket_scan_c2m.ply` — a copy of the point cloud carrying the cloud-to-mesh
  distance scalar field.
- `deviation_stats.json` — must include the five fields `dev_mean`, `dev_std`,
  `dev_max`, `dev_min`, `pct_over_0.5mm` (mm / ratio).
- `over_tolerance_regions.json` — JSON array of length 1–5; each element contains
  `centroid_xyz`, `max_dev_mm`, `point_count`, obtained by clustering every point
  whose deviation exceeds 0.5 mm.

Visual evidence screenshots (each must be a real screenshot of a cloud-to-mesh QC
tool UI, showing the DB tree / properties panel / 3D viewport / histogram and
other interface elements — do not synthesize images):
- `view_cc_loaded.png` — initial view with the point cloud and CAD mesh both
  loaded; UI elements and DB Tree visible.
- `view_cc_c2m_colormap.png` — 3D view after computing the cloud-to-mesh deviation
  and coloring it with a heatmap (red / green / blue gradient).
- `view_cc_histogram.png` — histogram view of the deviation scalar field, with
  the summary statistics (mean / std / max etc.) readable.
- `view_cc_max_deviation.png` — 3D view zoomed onto the **point of maximum
  deviation** (which falls in the localized defect region next to the M5 hole).
- `view_cc_cross_section.png` — cross-section view across the YZ plane, showing
  both the section outline and the deviation color distribution (revealing the
  overall warping of the wing).
- `view_cc_top_ortho.png` — orthographic projection looking down +Z.
- `view_cc_front_ortho.png` — orthographic projection looking along +X.

At least one histogram screenshot must contain readable statistical text (the
evaluator runs OCR on it).

Final deliverables:
- `root_cause.md` — ≥ 150 words. Combine the process information from
  `JOB_BRIEF.md` with the geometric location of the out-of-tolerance regions to
  infer likely machining / thermal-deformation / fixturing causes, and give at
  least 2 engineering improvement recommendations.
- `report.md` — ≥ 300 words, must include:
  - inspection overview (point count, ICP RMSE, filter ratio)
  - deviation statistics table (mean / std / max / min / % over tolerance)
  - out-of-tolerance region table (matching `over_tolerance_regions.json`)
  - markdown embeds of all 6 visual screenshots (`![](view_cc_*.png)` syntax)
  - root-cause summary
  - **PASS/FAIL** FAI verdict (PASS when max < 0.5 mm and pct_over < 5%, otherwise FAIL)
- `report.pdf` — converted from the markdown; at least 3 pages (screenshots
  embedded in the PDF).

### Red lines

- Do not copy any file from `gt/` into `results/`; every numerical value must
  come from your own processing pipeline.
- It is recommended to fix the deviation colormap to the absolute range
  [-0.5, 0.5] mm so the comparison against tolerance is intuitive, but the exact
  presentation is up to you.

parameters.warmup:
set +e
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
mkdir -p /tmp_workspace/results /tmp_workspace/state
chmod -R 777 /tmp_workspace 2>/dev/null || true
which pdal >/dev/null 2>&1 || timeout 120 apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=10 update -qq || true
which pdal >/dev/null 2>&1 || timeout 300 apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=10 install -y -qq pdal 2>/dev/null || true
timeout 600 apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=10 install -y -qq cloudcompare tesseract-ocr poppler-utils 2>/dev/null || true
pip3 install -q --break-system-packages --root-user-action=ignore trimesh numpy scipy rtree 2>/dev/null \
  || pip3 install -q --root-user-action=ignore trimesh numpy scipy rtree 2>/dev/null \
  || pip3 install -q --break-system-packages --root-user-action=ignore trimesh numpy scipy 2>/dev/null \
  || pip3 install -q --root-user-action=ignore trimesh numpy scipy 2>/dev/null || true
pip3 install -q --break-system-packages --root-user-action=ignore pytesseract 2>/dev/null \
  || pip3 install -q --root-user-action=ignore pytesseract 2>/dev/null || true
echo "[warmup] using trimesh + scipy.spatial.cKDTree for cloud-to-mesh analysis (no GUI)" > /tmp_workspace/state/warmup_note.txt
chmod -R 777 /tmp_workspace 2>/dev/null || true
echo "[warmup] SPA_task_14 done"

evaluator.desc: Run the WeaveBench rule-based grade() inside the VM and parse its REWARD score.
